definitions.explanation: The color green. Also refers to greenery, foliage, or verdure in nature.

examples.japanese: {緑|みどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.notes: Using の to modify a noun

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{緑|みどり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いっぱい→一杯：01793_ippai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

examples.english: The greenery visible from the window is very pleasant.

notes:
{緑|みどり} is a noun used both for the color green and for greenery/nature. As a noun, it modifies other nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {緑|みどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧ (green trees).

COLOR VS. GREENERY:
- {緑|みどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧: a green pen (color)
- {緑|みどり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: lots of greenery (nature)
- {緑|みどり}⟦{豊|ゆた}かな→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧: rich in greenery

CULTURAL NOTE:
In traditional Japanese, ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (blue) covered both blue and green. Even today, green traffic lights and green vegetables are called ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧: ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧ (green light), ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ (green vegetables). {緑|みどり} as a distinct color word became more common with Western influence.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{緑茶|りょくちゃ}→緑茶：10971_ryokucha⟧: green tea
- ⟦{緑地|りょくち}→緑地：25977_ryokuchi⟧: green space
- ⟦{新緑|しんりょく}→新緑：12724_shinryoku⟧: fresh green leaves (of spring)
